# hubspot_file_folder (Resource)

Manages one explicit HubSpot File folder by its generated `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hubspot_file_folder" "assets" {
  name = "Northstar assets"
}

resource "hubspot_file_folder" "brand" {
  name             = "Brand"
  parent_folder_id = hubspot_file_folder.assets.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) File folder name within its direct parent. It is mutable presentation, not identity.

### Optional

- `parent_folder_id` (String) Generated direct parent folder `id`. `null` means File Manager root.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) HubSpot RFC 3339 creation observation retained through in-place updates.
- `id` (String) HubSpot-generated folder `id` used as the only state and import identity.
- `path` (String) HubSpot-derived current folder path. It is an observation, never identity.
- `updated_at` (String) Current HubSpot RFC 3339 update observation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hubspot_file_folder.assets 123456789
```
